why: Five Chuck's Crew specials/trap shipped with no plate, so the app asked for art that 404'd. Mark asked for these five to be made in Gemini as strict photorealism.
generator: Gemini (Mark's Google AI Plus plan), by hand at gemini.google.com, with a Chuck reference image attached; exact prompt per plate below. Not called from the repo. Fal and other hosted generators remain banned.
pipeline: scripts/inpaint-card-art-fooocus.py --export-from (sharp cover crop to 768x1024 WebP + 192x256 thumb), then npm run art:thumbs --force (thumb/mid WebP+AVIF)
design_record: art/bear-bibles.json keeps each card's signature (character: chuck); the Fooocus manifest rows are composed from it.
superseded: A Fooocus pass (seeds 9202/3303/7202/9404/8505) was replaced before merge at Mark's request.

plates.name: Last Orders
plates.prompt: Keep this exact character design (same plush teddy bartender), but render him as a real physical plush toy in a real photograph. Last Orders. Night street photograph, 35mm lens, shot from a wet pavement through the plate-glass window of a real 1950s chrome-and-teal diner at closing time. Chuck stands behind the empty counter tipping a whisky bottle mid-pour into one last nightcap tumbler; beside it a second glass with a red lipstick print on the rim. Chairs upturned on tables, a mop bucket, harsh fluorescent light spilling onto the rainy street, reflections on the glass. Cool green-teal and ochre tones. Hyper-realistic real-world photograph, not an illustration, not a painting, not a cartoon, not 3D render, not CGI. Shot on a full-frame DSLR, real lens optics, natural depth of field, true-to-life lighting, physically accurate shadows and reflections, visible real fabric fibres and stitching on the plush toys, fine film grain, editorial product-photography realism. Chuck is a real, physical adult plush teddy bear toy (stuffed animal, not a living bear, not a human): honey-brown mohair plush, barrel chest, greying muzzle fur, half-lidded glass eyes, a loosened black satin bow tie, a teal short-sleeve shirt unbuttoned at the collar, one small gold tooth. All characters are adult plush teddy bear toys photographed in a real location. Cheeky adult bar humour by innuendo only. Portrait 3:4, subject centred with headroom for a card frame. No text, letters, numbers, logos, signage or watermark anywhere. No humans, no children.
